name: 江山美人
detailed_description:
Welcome to the martial arts world of "beauty"!

This is a mysterious and legendary world filled with adventures. You will play as a young martial arts novice embarking on a journey filled with challenges and surprises.

In this world, there are various martial arts sects and forces, such as Shaolin, Wudang, and Emei. Each sect has its unique martial arts secrets and cultivation methods. You can choose to join one of these sects, learn their martial arts, make like-minded brothers and sisters, and explore the Jianghu together.

However, the Jianghu is not just about sect rivalries. There are countless villains running amok. You need to continuously improve your martial arts skills, engage in friendly sparring with various experts, and challenge powerful enemies. Each battle requires you to flexibly use various martial arts techniques, master attack, defense, evasion, and other skills to emerge victorious in the Jianghu.

Besides battles, you also need to complete various missions and challenges. Some missions require you to delve deep into dens of iniquity and rescue civilians abducted by villains, while others involve exploring the secrets of the Jianghu and uncovering thrilling stories. Completing each mission will further enhance your martial arts skills and allow you to make more friends in the Jianghu.

In "beauty," you will experience the real martial arts world and feel the heroic aspirations of Jianghu heroes and heroines. You will leave your own legendary story in this world and become a martial arts master.

Come and join "beauty"! Write your own Jianghu legend with your sword! Whether you love thrilling battles or exploring the secrets of the Jianghu, this game has everything you desire. Let's pursue our Jianghu dreams in this fantastical and adventurous martial arts world!

short_description: A text-based placement game themed on martial arts, with a rich and precise weapon crafting system, appropriately challenging dungeons, slave capture, beauty recruitment, and diverse gameplay.
